title: Computing Topological Transition Sets for Line-Line-Circle Trisectors in $R^3$
summary: Computing the Voronoi diagram of mixed geometric objects in $R^3$ is challenging due to the high cost of exact geometric predicates via Cylindrical Algebraic Decomposition (CAD). We propose an efficient exact verification framework that characterizes the parameter space connectivity by computing certified topological transition sets. We analyze the fundamental non-quadric case: the trisector of two skew lines and one circle in $R^3$.
